text: [12] sampannasīlā bhikkhave viharatha sampannapātimokkhā pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu . sampannasīlānaṃ bhikkhave viharataṃ sampannapātimokkhānaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutānaṃ viharataṃ ācāragocara- sampannānaṃ aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvīnaṃ samādāya sikkhataṃ sikkhāpadesu kimassa uttarikaraṇīyaṃ carato cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjā ... byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ ... uddhaccakukkuccaṃ ... vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ caraṃpi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccati . ṭhitassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno ... nisinnassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno ... sayānassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa abhijjhā ... byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ ... uddhacca- kukkuccaṃ ... vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ sayānopi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccatīti . yatañcare yataṃ tiṭṭhe yataṃ acche yataṃ saye yataṃ sammiñjaye bhikkhu yatametaṃ pasāraye uddhaṃ tiriyaṃ apācīnaṃ yāvatā jagato gati samavekkhitā ca dhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ cetosamathasāmīciṃ sikkhamānaṃ sadāsatiṃ 1 satataṃ pahitattoti āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhanti .
